title: Flexible Packaging Materials for the Packing of Vanaspati in 10 kg and 15 kg Packs
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 14129) covers Flexible Packaging Materials for the Packing of Vanaspati in 10 kg and 15 kg Packs. This Insdian Standard was adopted by the the Pla tics Containers Sectional Committee htid been approved by the Petroleum, Coal and Related Products Division Council. The Packaging of Vanaspati has been an evolutionary shift in materials ever since the implementation of IS 113S2 : 1985 'Specification for flexible packs for packaging of vanaspati'. The Standards of Weights and Measures ( Packaged Commodities ) Rules 1977, stipulate the packaging quantities for cooking oils, vanaspati, ghee, magarine as 100 g, 200 g, 500 g, 1kg,.
